Subject: Confidential: Intake request — conduct concern & interim measures

Monica / Laura,

I need to submit a confidential intake. Over the past two weeks I've observed escalating behavior from Rishi that I believe crosses into inappropriate conduct and created a hostile environment for a direct report on my team. Specifics:

- On 2026-04-02 and 2026-04-05 he made multiple comments in a 1:1 and in a team channel directed at PII/compensation that were personal and aggressive.
- There are screenshots of DMs and a short Slack thread where Rishi says things that made the reportee feel threatened about performance consequences if they did not comply.

I have attached a redacted copy of the chat logs and screenshots (screenshots_20260406.zip, slack_export_20260406.json). The direct report has asked for confidentiality and specifically requested that I not share details with Rishi. They are concerned about retaliation.

Immediate asks:
- Please confirm intake and next steps.
- Advice on interim protections (no 1:1s alone, reassign technical review ownership) while HR investigates.
- Guidance on communications to the team (if any) that preserves confidentiality.

I have not had a substantive conversation with Rishi about these allegations beyond redirecting a meeting planned for today. I wanted HR/People to triage before any actions are taken.

Thanks,

Evelyn Hart
Engineering Manager, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Confidential: Intake request — conduct concern & interim measures

Evelyn — thanks for the detailed note and for preserving confidentiality. I appreciate you escalating promptly.

Quick confirmations / next steps:
1) Intake accepted. I will open an intake record and assign an investigator. Please do not engage Rishi about these allegations or attempt to gather additional statements from the reportee — that can create risk of perceived retaliation.
2) Interim measures: I agree we should immediately put a temporary no-contact expectation between Rishi and the reportee and avoid 1:1s. I will draft a brief manager script for you if you'd like.
3) Evidence preservation: thanks for the export. Please also preserve any relevant calendar invites and meeting recordings. Do not forward or post the attachments to other channels.
4) Timing: I'll schedule a 30-min intake call for tomorrow; legal (copied) will join if needed.

I am copying Laura for awareness. Rachel, please flag if you want outside counsel engaged now; otherwise we'll proceed with internal intake and loop counsel as needed.

Confidentiality reminder: This matter is treated as confidential. Company policy prohibits retaliation against anyone who raises concerns. See HR policy: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcEXAMPLE-HRINTAKE

I'll send the intake invite in a separate calendar item.

—Monica

Thanks — Evelyn
